ops.body:
cc-sync phase 2b integration complete: cc-sync/integration @ 7d2310178c7f (Run wf_866cfc96-f23). PR https://github.com/yasyf/cc-sync/pull/1 CI is GREEN on 7d23101: test (macOS), lint (GOOS=darwin), vuln, guides/pr-check, Socket.
Merged:
- catalog-fixes e2474b5 (D16);
- native-acceptance d3512be (restartable rollback);
- scheduler-stopfix 753bd85.
Decisions applied:
- Complete() ignores Orca omitted bindings. The golden diff shows only that change: aaa200 becomes ready and codex is listed under not_restorable.
- Relaxed stale relay: already in place.
- Pickup and resident use PickupReady (TestDefaultSkipsCheckpointsNotPickupReady).
CI fixes:
- ci.yml aligned with reposync/cookiesync: macOS tests, GOOS=darwin arm64 lint/vuln, timeouts.
- govulncheck found GO-2026-5972 (encoding/asn1) and GO-2026-5970 (x/text), both reachable. Fixed with toolchain go1.26.6 (same as the siblings) and x/text v0.39.0.
- cc-guides pr-check rejects PR edits to rendered files, so AGENTS.md/.pre-commit-config.yaml were reverted to main. Their fragment sources carry the intended edits (a dev-guide line; the pre-commit exclude for byte-exact native fixtures), and main's render job applies them after merge.
Leftovers for phase 2c:
- service detail() lists a mixed checkpoint's deferred reason twice;
- a resident status ready-count test with a populated catalog;
- plus the queued e2e CI job (git-lfs, GOWORK=off, -tags e2e) once the synckit final includes the harness.
